verses.en: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
verses.pt: Agradecei ao SENHOR, chamai o seu nome; anunciai suas obras entre os povos.
verses.en_web: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
verses.en_bbe: O give praise to the Lord; give honour to his name, talking of his doings among the peoples.

verses.en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.pt: Cantai a ele, tocai músicas para ele; falai de todas as suas maravilhas.
verses.en_web: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
verses.en_bbe: Let your voice be sounding in songs and melody; let all your thoughts be of the wonder of his works.

verses.en: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.pt: Tende orgulho de seu santo nome; alegre-se o coração dos que buscam ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
verses.en_bbe: Have glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who are searching after the Lord be glad.

verses.en: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
verses.pt: Buscai ao SENHOR e à sua força; buscai a presença dele continuamente.
verses.en_web: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
verses.en_bbe: Let your search be for the Lord and for his strength; let your hearts ever be turned to him.

verses.en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.pt: Lembrai-vos de suas maravilhas, que ele fez; de seus milagres, e dos juízos de sua boca.
verses.en_web: Remember his marvelous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind the great works which he has done; his wonders, and the decisions of his mouth;

verses.en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
verses.pt: Vós, que sois da semente de seu servo Abraão; vós, filhos de Jacó, seus escolhidos.
verses.en_web: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.en_bbe: O you seed of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his loved ones.

verses.en: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.pt: Ele é o SENHOR, nosso Deus; seus juízos estão em toda a terra.
verses.en_web: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: He is the Lord our God: he is judge of all the earth.

verses.en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
verses.pt: Ele se lembra para sempre de seu pacto, da palavra que ele mandou até mil gerações;
verses.en_web: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
verses.en_bbe: He has kept his agreement in mind for ever, the word which he gave for a thousand generations;

verses.en: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
verses.pt: O qual ele firmou com Abraão, e de seu juramento a Isaque.
verses.en_web: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
verses.en_bbe: The agreement which he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac;

verses.en: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
verses.pt: O qual também confirmou a Jacó como estatuto, a Israel como pacto eterno.
verses.en_web: and confirmed the same to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.en_bbe: And he gave it to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an eternal agreement;

verses.en: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
verses.pt: Dizendo: A ti darei a terra de Canaã, a porção de vossa herança.
verses.en_web: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance”;
verses.en_bbe: Saying, To you will I give the land of Canaan, the measured line of your heritage:

verses.en: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
verses.pt: Sendo eles poucos em número; eram poucos, e estrangeiros nela.
verses.en_web: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
verses.en_bbe: When they were still small in number, and strange in the land;

verses.en: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
verses.pt: E andaram de nação em nação, de um reino a outro povo.
verses.en_web: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
verses.en_bbe: When they went about from one nation to another, and from one kingdom to another people.

verses.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
verses.pt: Ele não permitiu a ninguém que os oprimisse; e por causa deles repreendeu a reis,
verses.en_web: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.en_bbe: He would not let anyone do them wrong; he even kept back kings because of them,

verses.en: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.pt: Dizendo: Não toqueis nos meus ungidos, e não façais mal a meus profetas.
verses.en_web: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, Put not your hand on those who have been marked with my holy oil, and do my prophets no wrong.

verses.en: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
verses.pt: E chamou a fome sobre a terra; ele interrompeu toda fonte de alimento;
verses.en_web: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
verses.en_bbe: And he took away all food from the land, so that the people were without bread.

verses.en: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
verses.pt: Enviou um homem adiante deles: José, que foi vendido como escravo.
verses.en_web: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
verses.en_bbe: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was given as a servant for a price:

verses.en: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
verses.pt: Amarraram seus pés em correntes; ele foi preso com ferros;
verses.en_web: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
verses.en_bbe: His feet were fixed in chains; his neck was put in iron bands;

verses.en: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
verses.pt: Até o tempo que sua mensagem chegou, a palavra do SENHOR provou o valor que ele tinha.
verses.en_web: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.
verses.en_bbe: Till the time when his word came true; he was tested by the word of the Lord.

verses.en: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
verses.pt: O rei mandou que ele fosse solto; o governante de povos o libertou.
verses.en_web: The king sent and freed him; even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
verses.en_bbe: The king sent men to take off his chains; even the ruler of the people, who let him go free.

verses.en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
verses.pt: Ele o pôs como senhor de sua casa, e por chefe de todos os seus bens,
verses.en_web: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions;
verses.en_bbe: He made him lord of his house, and ruler over everything he had;

verses.en: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
verses.pt: Para dar ordens a suas autoridades, e instruir a seus anciãos.
verses.en_web: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
verses.en_bbe: To give his chiefs teaching at his pleasure, and so that his law-givers might get wisdom from him.

verses.en: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.pt: Então Israel entrou no Egito; Jacó peregrinou na terra de Cam.
verses.en_web: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
verses.en_bbe: Then Israel came into Egypt, and Jacob was living in the land of Ham.

verses.en: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.pt: E fez seu povo crescer muito, e o fez mais poderoso que seus adversários.
verses.en_web: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
verses.en_bbe: And his people were greatly increased, and became stronger than those who were against them.

verses.en: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
verses.pt: E mudou o coração dos outros,para que odiassem ao seu povo, para que tratassem mal a seus servos.
verses.en_web: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
verses.en_bbe: Their hearts were turned to hate against his people, so that they made secret designs against them.

verses.en: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.pt: Então enviou seu servo Moisés, e a Arão, a quem tinha escolhido;
verses.en_web: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
verses.en_bbe: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, the man of his selection.

verses.en: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.pt: Que fizeram entre eles os sinais anunciados, e coisas sobrenaturais na terra de Cam.
verses.en_web: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.en_bbe: He let his signs be seen among the people, and his wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.en: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
verses.pt: Ele mandou trevas, e fez escurecer; e não foram rebeldes a sua palavra.
verses.en_web: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
verses.en_bbe: He sent black night and made it dark; and they did not go against his word.

verses.en: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.pt: Ele transformou suas águas em sangue, e matou a seus peixes.
verses.en_web: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
verses.en_bbe: At his word their waters were turned to blood, and he sent death on all their fish.

verses.en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.pt: A terra deles produziu rãs em abundância, até nos quartos de seus reis.
verses.en_web: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
verses.en_bbe: Their land was full of frogs, even in the rooms of the king.

verses.en: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
verses.pt: Ele falou, e vieram vários bichos e piolhos em todos os seus limites.
verses.en_web: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
verses.en_bbe: He gave the word, and there came the dog-fly, and insects over all the land.

verses.en: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
verses.pt: Tornou suas chuvas em saraiva; pôs fogo ardente em sua terra.
verses.en_web: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
verses.en_bbe: He gave them ice for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

verses.en: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
verses.pt: E feriu suas vinhas e seus figueirais; e quebrou as árvores de seus territórios.
verses.en_web: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
verses.en_bbe: He gave their vines and their fig-trees to destruction, and the trees of their land were broken down.

verses.en: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
verses.pt: Ele falou, e vieram gafanhotos, e incontáveis pulgões;
verses.en_web: He spoke, and the locusts came, and the grasshoppers, without number,
verses.en_bbe: At his word the locusts came, and young locusts more than might be numbered,

verses.en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.pt: E comeram toda a erva de sua terra; e devoraram o fruto de seus campos.
verses.en_web: ate up every plant in their land; and ate up the fruit of their ground.
verses.en_bbe: And put an end to all the plants of their land, taking all the fruit of the earth for food.

verses.en: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
verses.pt: Também feriu a todos os primogênitos em sua terra; os primeiros de todas as suas forças.
verses.en_web: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
verses.en_bbe: He put to death the first child of every family in the land, the first-fruits of their strength.

verses.en: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
verses.pt: E os tirou dali com prata e ouro; e dentre suas tribos não houve quem tropeçasse.
verses.en_web: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
verses.en_bbe: He took his people out with silver and gold: there was not one feeble person among them.

verses.en: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
verses.pt: Até o Egito se alegrou com a saída deles, porque seu temor tinha caído sobre eles.
verses.en_web: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
verses.en_bbe: Egypt was glad when they went; for the fear of them had come down on them.

verses.en: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
verses.pt: Ele estendeu uma nuvem como cobertor, e um fogo para iluminar a noite.
verses.en_web: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
verses.en_bbe: A cloud was stretched over them for a cover; and he sent fire to give light in the night.

verses.en: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.pt: Eles pediram, e fez vir codornizes; e os fartou com pão do céu.
verses.en_web: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
verses.en_bbe: At the people's request he sent birds, and gave them the bread of heaven for food.

verses.en: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.pt: Ele abriu uma rocha, e dela saíram águas; e correram como um rio pelos lugares secos;
verses.en_web: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
verses.en_bbe: His hand made the rock open, and the waters came streaming out; they went down through the dry places like a river.

verses.en: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
verses.pt: Porque se lembrou de sua santa palavra, e de seu servo Abraão.
verses.en_web: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
verses.en_bbe: For he kept in mind his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

verses.en: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
verses.pt: Então ele tirou dali a seu povo com alegria; e seus eleitos com celebração.
verses.en_web: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
verses.en_bbe: And he took his people out with joy, the men of his selection with glad cries:

verses.en: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
verses.pt: E lhes deu as terras das nações; e do trabalho das nações tomaram posse;
verses.en_web: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
verses.en_bbe: And gave them the lands of the nations; and they took the work of the peoples for a heritage;

verses.en: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.pt: Para que guardassem seus estatutos, e obedecessem a leis dele. Aleluia!
verses.en_web: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
verses.en_bbe: So that they might keep his orders, and be true to his laws. Give praise to the Lord.
